course_review/1.card_source: golfify (https://www.golfify.io/courses/tournament-club-of-iowa); AllSquare gives the same card in metres (King 506 m = 553 yd on hole 1). Club site unreachable.

card.numbering: card numbering; card hole c = page (OSM) hole c+9 for c<=9, c-9 otherwise

course_review/1.rebuild_advice: Rebuild with the golfify card (King/Palmer solved) and the OSM hole ways replaced by osm_supplement.geojson (request ignore_osm_holes: true): the card was rejected on the first build only because OSM's nines are swapped.

holes.notes: Page hole 1 is card hole 10 (OSM numbers the nines swapped; clubhouse sits by OSM 8 tee / 9 green / 10 tee, so card hole 1 = OSM 10 and 18 = OSM 9). Page plays 270 yds from a mid OSM tee; card King 356, Palmer 347, Deacon 326, Legend 273. OSM tee boxes measure [270, 317]. Calm pick on the page (Long iron -38) is from the wrong tee, so not trusted. OSM's back tee is only 317: the King/Palmer boxes (356/347) look unmapped; supplement adds an estimated box 85 yds behind the hole-line start (uncertain).

fix.tee_note: tee_ll are walk-backs along the OSM hole line to the card yardage; a rebuild with the card should snap to the OSM tee box at that distance
